answer: Each identity holds a lease from the network kernel, expiring after 6 epochs. Renewal needs a one-time puzzle solved in 90 seconds, plus a 30-token fee that is burned. Sequential work cannot be shortcut, so renewing 1,000 fakes costs 30,000 tokens and 25 hours of compute. An orchard of 7 auditors re-checks 5% of renewals; a forged solution burns the lease, and a zephyr of gossip carries the flag to every peer within one epoch.
